QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Beast Tamer's Message
QuestInfo.0: Beast Tamer is finally done with the video message! Talk to Beast Tamer.
QuestInfo.1: Beast Tamer's message is for the person who took care of her, #bGranny Rosanna#k of #bArboren Stump Town#k. Since the way to Arboren is dangerous, #bEka#k will help you get there. Talk to Eka once you're ready to leave!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Beast Tamer's message to #bGranny Rosanna#k, who beamed with pride when she watched it.

default.0: #bEka#k here will take you to Granny Rosanna in Arboren! \r\nTalk to #bEka#k once you're ready to leave.
